races.display_title: Virgin Bet Celebration Mile Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict: Sole 3-y-o ZAVATERI has had a relatively light season and shaped as if the step back up to this trip would suit when fifth at York last week. He could be the answer here. Boiling Point rarely runs a bad race and looks sure to make his presence felt, whilst Seagulls Eleven is much better than he showed here last time and is also respected. ZAVATERI (IRE) BOILING POINT (IRE) SEAGULLS ELEVEN (IRE)

races.display_title: Heider Family Stables Round Tower Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict: A good-looking renewal of this Group 3 based on Timeform pre-race ratings. Unbeaten No Nay Never Colt GREAT BARRIER REEF did well to land the Coventry Stakes at Royal Ascot and, while it’s a slight concern he’s not been seen since, he’s still taken to overcome a 5 lb penalty and provide Aidan O’Brien with a third successive win in the race. Livenka certainly impressed in landing the odds at Naas and is feared most. GREAT BARRIER REEF (IRE) LIVENKA VELOZEE (IRE)

races.display_title: Tote Irish Cambridgeshire (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict: One of Ireland's premier handicaps and it looks another typically competitive renewal. PIERRE ROYAL is still relatively unexposed after just 7 career starts and once again left the impression there's a valuable 1m handicap with his name on it when fourth in another strongly-contested event at the Galway Festival on his latest outing. Loughrea is progressing notably well and looks the type to win more races, while Johnny Soda a, Kalir and Hellorhighwater are others to take seriously. PIERRE ROYAL (IRE) LOUGHREA (IRE) JOHNNY SODA (IRE)

races.display_title: Tattersalls 40,000 EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: THI QAR has been entered in Group races on the back of her encouraging debut second at Newmarket and is taken to improve past the more-established Tall Trees . Money for one or more of the newcomers would also bring them into the reckoning, with Flower Show one who makes obvious appeal given Charlie Appleby's excellent 2-y-o strike-rate. THI QAR (IRE) TALL TREES FLOWER SHOW (IRE)

races.display_title: Zyn Frontrunner Finish Handicap
races.verdict: The handicapper hasn't missed KOKBASTAU after Kempton but it still might not stop this fast-improving 3-y-o. Fellow 3-y-o My Love Is King failed to figure in a Group 3 at Royal Ascot but retains potential back from a break and is second choice ahead of Alcarath and last year's Balmoral winner Crown of Oaks , who has been given a bit of time to get over a below-par reappearance in Ireland. KOKBASTAU MY LOVE IS KING ALCARATH (IRE)

races.verdict: SOLAR ACLAIM had excuses on account of the ground/way the race developed at Chester when last seen in June and is on a workable mark judged on the pick of last season's efforts, so could be worth chancing to quickly bounce back. This is competitive though, with Sir Yoshi and Newcastle scorer Lethal Nymph just 2 potential threats. SOLAR ACLAIM (IRE) SIR YOSHI (IRE) LETHAL NYMPH
races.betting_forecast: Lethal Nymph (7/2), Sir Yoshi (9/2), Paddy's Day (11/2), Francisco's Piece (11/2), Temple Of Athena (6/1), Trilby (7/1), Vintage Clarets (10/1), Cinque Verde (12/1), Solar Aclaim (14/1), Baldomero (20/1), Exclamation (33/1)

races.verdict: LEQUINTO can race off the same mark as when an unlucky third here recently so is fancied to bag a remarkable ninth course success. Supreme King also didn't enjoy the rub of the green when fifth at Chester last time and rates a big threat in his bid for a fifth victory of 2026. Both Amazonian Dream and Under The Twilight also possess excellent course records and can play a prominent role too in this competitive sprint. LEQUINTO (IRE) SUPREME KING (IRE) AMAZONIAN DREAM (IRE)

races.verdict: PASSING DIAMOND looked a natural when accounting for a subsequent winner from 4 lb out of the weights on his chasing debut over C&D last month and is capable of following up on that evidence. Palamon has been considerately handled on both comeback runs this summer and needs keeping a close eye on in the betting, especially with Harry Skelton now back in the saddle. PASSING DIAMOND (IRE) PALAMON (IRE) LERMOOS LEGEND

races.verdict: A mere 2 lb rise for last month's C&D success arguably underestimates AILL DUBH 's superiority on the day and with his stable continuing to go well, he can follow up.
